purpose: Qualify an ordinary non-AppContainer test token while preserving production protected user-only record ACLs and the existing OS-enforced scratch boundary.
grant: Existing owner grant for Windows10 guest development/testing and guest administration. Agents remains the sole routine coordinator; no guest Jules or routine Codex use.
candidate: Use a fresh owned temporary standard-user principal with an exact SID/nonce journal; no persistent extra administrator or change to shared accounts. Remove it only after all owned tokens/jobs have retired.
Authenticate only that owned account through a credential kept outside Git/logs. Do not reset Agents, Codex or Jules. No inherited host credential or network-only logon.

CreateRestrictedToken with DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE and WRITE_RESTRICTED and the exact fresh user SID; do not use SANDBOX_INERT or broad restricting SIDs. Actual resulting token must be nonelevated/non-AppContainer and not an administrator.

The fresh user has no preexisting writable profile outside the cap. Keep TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR and all selected user-state roots inside owned scratch. No profile load or fallback is admitted without separate measured accounting.

Use the documented CreateProcessWithTokenW/STARTUPINFOEX path with existing guest coordinator privileges, an explicit handle list and private desktop. Do not grant new host or guest policy rights to make launch succeed.

Source is read-only to that principal; its own user SID grants writes only under the owned cap. Reads outside scratch remain limited by the ordinary user ACLs. Keep process/job/resource controls and explicit descendant retirement.
required_actual_controls: Bind guest, coordinator, fresh principal, source, volume UUID/capacity and exact token properties before execution.
A protected exact-user-only record can be created, reopened, read and updated by the actual restricted child without adding a package/group ACE to product records.

An owned outside control that grants ordinary group write access rejects the restricted child write; source changes and other declared outside targets are denied. No write spillover after allocation failure.
Reach the32MiB hard filesystem limit and record actual allocation denial and remaining host/guest reserves; no quota/budget increase.
Demonstrate owned descendant interruption, zero surviving child handles/processes, source restoration, scratch/image/account/profile cleanup and preservation of unrelated work.
Only after this proof, run a representative actual native build/store journey. A successful primitive probe alone does not admit the full178-group composition.
not_claimed: No implementation, account creation or native proof has occurred for this candidate.
No full product, AppContainer admission, cross-package worker budget, other OS or physical-device qualification.
